name: tsamaya-website
description: Marketing + info website for Tsamaya (Go well.) — static site, zero runtime dependencies.
//: The BUILD has no dependencies: `node build.mjs` runs on a clean checkout with no npm install, which is why CI needs nothing. The devDependencies are for manual steps whose output is committed: sharp for `npm run images`, and esbuild, three, gsap and lenis for `npm run vendor` (writes public/vendor/). Never move any of them to dependencies. `npm run shapes` needs Python and shapely (the pipeline venv, or set PYTHON) plus Supabase credentials in the environment; like `stats` and `bounds` it is a manual step whose output is committed.
